about.description:
HiggsTools is a toolbox for comparing BSM models with extended scalar
sectors to experimental results. It unifies and extends HiggsBounds and
HiggsSignals in modern C++ with a native Python interface, and contains
the sub-libraries HiggsPredictions, HiggsBounds and HiggsSignals. The
experimental data sets are distributed separately
(https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/hbdataset and
https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/hsdataset).
about.summary: HiggsPredictions, HiggsBounds, HiggsSignals - comparing extended Higgs sectors to collider results

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.1.3"

recipe:
  name: higgstools-suite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/higgstools/-/archive/v${{ version }}/higgstools-v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 71464d8836cfdb8a6094ed9d2fd13e633b80c215845e62af3d0d5cecdd955767
  patches:
    # Upstream downloads range-v3, magic_enum, fmt, spdlog, nlohmann_json,
    # Eigen, pybind11 and Catch2 with FetchContent at configure time. Use the
    # conda-forge packages via find_package() instead (FetchContent kept
    # behind -DHiggsTools_FETCH_DEPENDENCIES=ON). Also adds the missing
    # include(GNUInstallDirs).
    - use-find_package-for-dependencies-instead-of-FetchContent.patch
    # Upstream pins fmt 8.0.1; conda-forge pins fmt 12. Make formatter::format
    # const and stop relying on implicit enum formatting.
    - support-fmt-10-and-newer.patch
    # magic_enum >= 0.9 moved ostream_operators to magic_enum_iostream.hpp
    - support-magic_enum-0.9-in-tests.patch
    # Option to link the Python extension module against the installed
    # libHiggsTools instead of compiling the library sources into it again.
    - link-python-module-against-installed-libHiggsTools.patch
    # The CMake project version was left at 0.0.6 upstream, which setup.py
    # uses for the Python package metadata and CMake writes to
    # HiggsToolsConfigVersion.cmake. This should get fixed upstream; until then
    # update this patch on every version bump (the dist-info test below fails
    # if it is out of date).
    - set-project-version-to-1.1.3.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:
  # Build and install the C++ library once, then split the installed files
  # into the runtime library and the -devel package.
  - staging:
      name: libhiggstools-build
    build:
      script:
        file: build-lib.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake >=3.17
        - ninja
      host:
        - range-v3
        - magic_enum
        - fmt
        - spdlog
        - nlohmann_json
        # The installed headers only include the C++ standard library (Eigen
        # is linked privately), so use eigen and not eigen-abi-devel.
        # See https://github.com/conda-forge/eigen-feedstock/blob/main/recipe/README.md
        - eigen
        - catch2
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          # Only used to build the test suite
          - catch2

  - package:
      name: libhiggstools
    inherit: libhiggstools-build
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libHiggsTools.*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        # libHiggsTools.so has no SOVERSION, so pin to patch level
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libhiggstools', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - HiggsTools

  - package:
      name: libhiggstools-devel
    inherit:
      from: libhiggstools-build
      # Headers and CMake config only; the library's dependencies come from
      # libhiggstools.
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - include/Higgs/
        - lib/cmake/HiggsTools/
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libhiggstools', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libhiggstools', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - Higgs/Predictions.hpp
            - Higgs/Bounds.hpp
            - Higgs/Signals.hpp
            - Higgs/HiggsTools_export.h
          files:
            - lib/cmake/HiggsTools/HiggsToolsConfig.cmake
            - lib/cmake/HiggsTools/HiggsToolsConfigVersion.cmake

      - files:
          recipe:
            - cmake_test/
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - ninja
        script:
          - cmake -S cmake_test -B cmake_test/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$PREFIX"
          - cmake --build cmake_test/build
          - ./cmake_test/build/higgstools_test

  - package:
      name: higgstools
    build:
      script:
        env:
          CMAKE_GENERATOR: Ninja
        content:
          # scikit-build (classic) forwards CMAKE_ARGS to CMake
          - export CMAKE_ARGS="${CMAKE_ARGS} -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${PREFIX} -DPython_EXECUTABLE=${PYTHON} -DHiggsTools_FETCH_DEPENDENCIES=OFF -DHiggsTools_PYTHON_USE_INSTALLED_LIBRARY=ON"
          - ${PYTHON} -m pip install . -vv
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake >=3.17
        - ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - pybind11
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - scikit-build
        # Imported by setup.py but not listed in pyproject.toml
        - packaging
        - pybind11
        - libhiggstools-devel
        - range-v3
        - magic_enum
        - fmt
      run:
        # _Higgs links against libHiggsTools, which has no SOVERSION and no ABI
        # guarantee across releases, so require the exact build from this recipe
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libhiggstools', exact=True) }}
        - python
        - numpy
        - scipy
        - pandas
        - requests
        - matplotlib-base
        # Needed by Higgs.tools.Input.readHB5SLHA() but not listed upstream
        - pylha

    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - Higgs
            - Higgs.predictions
            - Higgs.bounds
            - Higgs.signals
            - Higgs.tools.Input
          pip_check: true
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - lib/python*/site-packages/higgstools-${{ version }}.dist-info/METADATA
      - files:
          recipe:
            - test_higgstools.py
        script:
          - python ./test_higgstools.py
        requirements:
          run:
            - python

about:
  homepage: https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/higgstools
  repository: https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/higgstools
  documentation: https://higgsbounds.gitlab.io/higgstools/
  summary: HiggsPredictions, HiggsBounds, HiggsSignals - comparing extended Higgs sectors to collider results
  description: |
    HiggsTools is a toolbox for comparing BSM models with extended scalar
    sectors to experimental results. It unifies and extends HiggsBounds and
    HiggsSignals in modern C++ with a native Python interface, and contains
    the sub-libraries HiggsPredictions, HiggsBounds and HiggsSignals. The
    experimental data sets are distributed separately
    (https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/hbdataset and
    https://gitlab.com/higgsbounds/hsdataset).
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: higgstools
  recipe-maintainers:
    - matthewfeickert
